subject: SET statement
notes: kb/Work/PB461.md LANDED (transferred from PB462 in wave 39). Citation re-derived on this tree, not inherited: cite.py --check 14.9.39.4 "If the TRUE phrase is specified, the literal in the VALUE clause associated with condition-name-1 is placed in the conditional variable according to the rules for the VALUE clause" -> OK (General rules 6). ALL FOUR CLAIMS OF THE ROW NOW HOLD, RE-MEASURED ON THIS WORKTREE'S OWN BUILD. HOLDS 1 (the FIRST literal of a list / the low end of a THRU range) and HOLDS 2 (an ordinary literal and a bare figurative word) were already true and are unchanged. BROKEN 1 -- 'according to the rules for the VALUE clause' NOT honoured for an ALL literal -- IS FIXED AT ITS ROOT: the rule was written down in FIVE private ALL-strips (ValueInitializer.FigurativeKind glued-only, ConditionRenderer.FigurativeFillChar whitespace-only, SetEmitter.FigurativeWordFill whitespace-or-letter, DataBinder.NumericLiteralValue whitespace-only, DataBinder.ValidateValueCategory no-trim) each of which recognized a DIFFERENT subset of the spellings 8.3.3.6.2 admits, and the SET emitter had no Format-6 arm at all. They are replaced by ONE classifier, FigurativeConstants.Classify, which parts an operand into Formats 1-5 (where the word ALL is OPTIONAL -- only Format 6 underlines it) and Format 6 (ALL literal-1), in BOTH the glued spelling the parse tree's GetText produces and the spaced one. MEASURED AFTER: `88 A-ALLSTAR VALUE ALL "*"` on PIC X(4) SETs to [****] and its own condition reads back TRUE (was [ALL"] and ROUNDTRIP-FALSE); ALL "AB" on X(4) gives [ABAB] and on X(5) [ABABA], which is 8.3.3.6.4 GR2's repeat-then-truncate-from-the-right and not a whole-copy fill; ALL SPACES / ALL QUOTES / ALL ZEROS now TEST true as well as store correctly (the TEST arm's strip fired only before a space and so never fired at all on the glued text). Also fixed under the same rule: a figurative ZERO on a NUMERIC conditional variable reached UnscaledAtScale with the WORD and emitted the bare identifier ZEROL, a Roslyn CS0103 that failed the whole compilation of legal COBOL -- 8.3.3.6.4 GR4 ('the zero format represents the numeric value 0 ... depending on context') now gives it 0 at the store and at the test. BROKEN 2 (a GROUP conditional variable emitting uncompilable C#) was fixed on main by kb/Work PB728 before this landing and is RE-MEASURED here as correct: `01 CV. 88 CV-YES VALUE "ABC". 05 P1 PIC X ...` SETs to [ABC] and reads back true, a group with a subordinate ODO table SETs and reads back true, and the zero-length arm ('If the length of the conditional variable is zero, the SET statement leaves it unchanged') no longer fails to compile -- FUNCTION LENGTH of the ODO group at DEPENDING 0 is 0 and the SET is a no-op. GR7's FALSE arm rides the same store and was re-measured with an ALL-literal FALSE phrase (AT=[****] then AF=[ABAB]); GR7's own row is GR-14.9.39.4-7, owned by kb/Work PB455, and is NOT re-verdicted here. EDITIONS: the TRUE phrase is core COBOL-85 and the behaviour does not differ by edition, so the positive golden runs at 85 and its category twin (national and boolean literal-1, 8.3.3.6.3 SR2's other two classes) at 2002 where those literals were introduced; the negative is rejected at all four. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/CodeGen/Emit/ConditionRenderer.cs#StringMembershipValue (kb/Work PB1477 folded StringMembershipValue into StringMembershipOperand (the ONE FigurativeConstants.Classify read of an 88 VALUE operand stays there); the method no longer exists)
